blocks.text: Inside Abbotsford's 55+ Adult Apartment Condo Communities

parts.t: Abbotsford has one of the largest concentrations of 55+ adult-oriented apartment buildings in British Columbia, anchored around Mill Lake Park, Sevenoaks Shopping Centre, Gladwin Road, and Clearbrook. Designed for retirees and downsizers who want lock-and-leave convenience without stairs, these buildings typically offer much larger floor plans (often 950 to 1,400+ sq ft with full-sized laundry rooms, dining areas, and enclosed sunrooms/solariums) than newer investor-oriented condos.

Many 55+ condo buildings around Mill Lake Park (Bevan Avenue, Ware Street, and Primrose Street) and Clearbrook include community-focused amenities tailored to active seniors: woodworking shops, social lounges with communal kitchens, billiards and craft rooms, guest suites for visiting family, car-wash bays, and secure underground parking. Because 55+ age restrictions remain fully enforceable under British Columbia's Strata Property Act—and 55+ buildings may also still enforce rental limits—these buildings maintain high owner-occupancy and quiet hallways.

blocks.text: What to Check in 55+ Condo Bylaws, Fees, and Depreciation Reports

parts.t: When comparing 55+ condos in Abbotsford, check four items in the strata documents: (1) confirm whether the monthly strata fee includes hot water, natural gas (for gas fireplaces), or radiant heat, which are common inclusions in Mill Lake and Clearbrook buildings; (2) verify the exact age-restriction bylaw (55+ requires at least one occupant to be 55 or older, with statutory exemptions for spouses and caregivers); (3) check whether enclosed balconies or solariums were enclosed with strata permission; and (4) review the Depreciation Report and 24 months of strata council minutes for elevator modernization, domestic re-piping, and roof membrane status.

blocks.text: 7 Common Questions About Abbotsford 55+ Condos for Sale

parts.t: Where are most 55+ apartment condos located in Abbotsford?

Almost all 55+ condo buildings in Abbotsford are located in Central Abbotsford (walking distance to Mill Lake Park, Sevenoaks Shopping Centre, and Gladwin Road medical clinics) and in Clearbrook along Clearbrook Road and George Ferguson Way.
What is the typical price range for a 55+ condo in Abbotsford?

One-bedroom and two-bedroom 55+ condos in Abbotsford typically range from $260,000 to $525,000 depending on square footage, building construction (wood-frame vs concrete), renovation level, and Mill Lake or mountain views.
Can a 55+ condo building in Abbotsford still restrict rentals?

Yes. Under British Columbia's Strata Property Act, buildings with a valid 55+ age-restriction bylaw are exempt from the province-wide ban on strata rental restrictions, meaning many 55+ buildings in Abbotsford remain predominantly owner-occupied.
Who is allowed to live in a 55+ condo in British Columbia?

At least one resident occupying the suite must be 55 years of age or older. Under BC Strata Property Regulations, a younger spouse or partner residing with the 55+ occupant, as well as live-in caregivers, are legally permitted to live in the unit.
What amenities are common in Abbotsford 55+ condo buildings?

Many 55+ buildings around Mill Lake and Clearbrook feature guest suites for out-of-town visitors, social/banquet rooms, woodworking workshops, hobby/craft rooms, libraries, and enclosed four-season solariums.
Do 55+ condos in Abbotsford allow pets?

Some 55+ condo buildings allow one small dog or indoor cat, while several established buildings near Mill Lake and Clearbrook have no-pet bylaws (subject to certified guide/service dog exemptions). Always check the current bylaws before offering.
